meta.notes: Comprehensive Moldova EV charging operator research conducted. All known public operators identified and catalogued. Tariffs retrieved directly from operator websites where available. Road tax rates provided by stakeholder. EVPoint confirmed as market leader; eCharge Moldova tariffs not publicly listed (app-only); OMV Petrom/Renovatio announced Moldova entry in 2024 but Moldova station data unconfirmed.

ev_charging_operators_overview.summary: As of April 2026, three active public charging networks have been confirmed operating in Moldova. EVPoint is the dominant player. eCharge Moldova operates a B2B platform with app-only pricing. EVGP operates 3 DC fast-charge stations. OMV Petrom/Renovatio announced Moldova expansion in mid-2024 but public Moldova-specific station/tariff data was not accessible. Plugpoint (Romanian) is available as an app in Moldova but station presence is unconfirmed.

EVPoint.confidence: HIGH — retrieved directly from EVPoint official tariff page
EVPoint.network_size: 120+ stations, 270+ charging points (as of Dec 2023; actively expanding)
EVPoint.max_power_notes: 150 kW DC available in Chișinău; lower power at other locations
EVPoint.unit: MDL per EV (1 EV = 1 kWh conventional billing unit, prices include TVA)
EVPoint.billing_note: EV is a conventional billing unit equal to 1 kWh consumption. Prices listed are 'from' — individual station tariffs may differ. Always verify before charging.
EVPoint.payment_methods: Prepaid balance top-up via Victoriabank (card); RFID card available on request

EVGP.confidence: HIGH — retrieved directly from EVGP official site
EVGP.payment_methods: RFID card + iOS/Android app + online payment

eCharge_Moldova.confidence: LOW for tariffs (not published) — HIGH for operator existence
eCharge_Moldova.address: or. Chișinău, str. Calea Moșilor 28, Rodaris Office, of. 205
eCharge_Moldova.tariff_availability: Tariffs are only visible within the mobile app after registration. No public pricing page found on website.
eCharge_Moldova.platform_type: B2B + end-user platform — manages third-party station infrastructure
eCharge_Moldova.research_notes: eCharge Moldova (ECAR CONCEPT SRL) is a B2B-oriented integrated EV charging platform. Their website focuses on attracting location partners rather than publishing consumer tariffs. Pricing is set per station by location operators and only visible in the app post-login. No pricing found on website, Facebook, or any public source.

OMV_Petrom_Renovatio.confidence: LOW — announced entry, Moldova-specific stations unconfirmed
OMV_Petrom_Renovatio.status: ANNOUNCED — expansion into Moldova planned as of mid-2024
OMV_Petrom_Renovatio.legal_entity: OMV Petrom S.A. (acquired Renovatio Asset Management, Romania)
OMV_Petrom_Renovatio.tariff_availability: No Moldova-specific tariff page found. Romanian tariffs apply in Romania; Moldova pricing unknown.
OMV_Petrom_Renovatio.connector_types: Multiple (22 kW AC to 360 kW DC in Romanian network)
OMV_Petrom_Renovatio.research_notes: OMV Petrom acquired Renovatio Asset Management (largest EV charging network in Romania, 400+ charge points) in June 2024. Company announced goal of 1,000 charge points across Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia, and Moldova by end of 2024. No confirmed Moldova station data or tariff pages were accessible at time of research. OMV Petrom Moldova website (omvpetrom.md) did not load.

Plugpoint.source: Apple App Store (Moldova region) + plugpoint.ro — reviewed 29 April 2026
Plugpoint.confidence: LOW — app available in Moldova App Store; physical station presence unconfirmed
Plugpoint.status: UNCONFIRMED — app available but Moldova stations not verified
Plugpoint.tariff_availability: No Moldova-specific tariffs found. Plugpoint.ro is a Romanian B2B EV charging hardware/software company.
Plugpoint.research_notes: Plugpoint mobile app is listed on the Apple App Store for Moldova. The developer is Charge Point SRL, a Romanian company providing EV charging hardware and software to businesses. It is unclear whether they operate any stations in Moldova or merely supply equipment used by Moldovan operators.

ev_road_tax_annual.confidence: MEDIUM — provided by Dumitru Volosciuc; not independently verified against official Fiscal Code text
ev_road_tax_annual.basis: Moldova Fiscal Code Title IX, Annex 2 — taxa pentru folosirea drumurilor, per kg of masa totală autorizată (maximum allowed weight)
ev_road_tax_annual.unit: MDL per kg of maximum allowed weight (masa totală autorizată), charged annually
ev_road_tax_annual.calculation_method: Flat rate: the rate corresponding to the vehicle's masa totală autorizată bracket is applied to the full weight in kg. Annual tax = masa_totală_autorizată_kg × rate_MDL_per_kg.
ev_road_tax_annual.note: Rates provided by Dumitru Volosciuc. Verify against Annex 2 of Title IX of Codul Fiscal nr. 1163/1997 or via the SFS road tax calculator at https://sfs.md.
